tldr: Mars in Capricorn: action is disciplined, ambitious, and built for results.
body: With Mars in Capricorn, Mars is exalted, so drive can become focused, strategic, and remarkably effective. Energy works best when pointed toward a concrete goal.
gift: Endurance, executive force, patience, and the ability to turn effort into achievement.
challenge: Ruthlessness, overwork, and treating every goal like a mountain to conquer.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
